name: month-end
title: Month-end
subtitle: Last closed month against the approved budget, what still needs a comment, and the close checklist

sections.title: Variances that need a comment
sections.note: Over both thresholds in the settings table and not yet explained.
sections.sql: select entity, month, code, account, owner as budget_holder, actual, budget, variance, pct from v_commentary_due order by entity, abs(variance) desc

sections.title: Close checklist
sections.sql: select entity, month, task, owner, due_on, done_on, state from v_close c where c.period = (select max(period) from close_tasks t where t.entity_id = c.entity_id) order by entity, state, due_on

sections.title: Where the year lands
sections.sql: select entity, currency, code, account, actual_to_date, forecast_rest, outlook, budget, gap from v_outlook order by entity, code

sections.title: Forecast not rolled
sections.sql: select entity, months as closed_months_still_forecast from v_unrolled order by entity

name: cash-and-covenants
title: Cash and covenants
subtitle: Closing cash on actuals then the current forecast, and every bank covenant test

sections.title: Cash
sections.sql: select entity, currency, month, basis, closing_cash from v_cash order by entity, period

sections.title: Covenants
sections.sql: select entity, lender, metric, test, threshold, last_tested, last_value, last_passed, first_forecast_breach, breach_value from v_covenants order by entity, metric

sections.title: Every covenant test
sections.sql: select entity, lender, metric, month, basis, value, passes from v_covenant_tests order by entity, metric, period

name: plan
title: The plan
subtitle: Versions, the hiring plan and distributions

sections.title: Versions
sections.sql: select name, kind, to_char(starts_on, 'YYYY-MM') as starts, to_char(ends_on, 'YYYY-MM') as ends, locked, approved_by, approved_on, line_count from v_versions order by kind, starts_on

sections.title: Hiring plan
sections.sql: select entity, role, person, status, starts_on, ends_on, annual_salary, oncost_rate, monthly_cost, cost_in_forecast from v_headcount where status <> 'cancelled' order by entity, starts_on

sections.title: Distributions
sections.sql: select entity, currency, amount, status, declared_on, pay_on, solvency_certificate_on, net_assets_before, lowest_cash_after from v_distributions order by pay_on

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule, item, finding from v_compliance order by rule, item

sections.title: GST and BAS
sections.sql: select entity, return_type, period_end, due_on, lodged_on, state from v_tax_calendar order by due_on desc

sections.title: Needs a person
sections.sql: select item, issue, detail from v_attention order by issue, item
